name: pkg_metadata_sync
description: Package metadata maintenance (proposals_v1 rank 3): a real export()/importFrom()/S3method() directive from a tarball NAMESPACE (or a package entry from a DESCRIPTION Imports: block) is reverse-stripped from its alphabetically sorted slot; the completion re-inserts the exact line. Ground truth = the verbatim file line - exact by construction (tier 1).
novelty_note: Only format_propagation touches non-.R files (and only R/ members); nothing edits package metadata. NAMESPACE/DESCRIPTION members are streamed from the CRAN tarballs with the python-tarfile reader (format_propagation infra). Sortedness is verified per directive type at scan time (only strictly sorted roxygen2-style files emit items); the row_check re-verifies the slot: the entry sorts strictly between its same-kind neighbours. Fully corpus-side (reverse-strip): generated via the mock backend - the model draw is not the gate. Deviation from the proposal: no event_diff (the cases-harness scenario_block check forbids it); the sorted-neighbourhood context carries the signal instead.
